description:
The Medical Check-Up facility under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) was launched to provide essential health services to construction workers in Uttarakhand.

This scheme was officially initiated in the year 2018.

The primary objective of the Medical Check-Up facility is to ensure that construction workers receive regular health check-ups.

The goal is to improve the overall health and well-being of workers engaged in the construction industry.

The scheme aims to provide free medical check-ups to all registered construction workers in Uttarakhand.

The specific target is to cover a minimum of 50,000 construction workers annually.

The benefits of this scheme include free health check-ups for registered workers.

Workers can avail of services such as blood tests, urine tests, and general health assessments.

The scheme also provides referrals to specialized medical services if required.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial.

Each registered worker can receive health check-up services worth up to INR 5,000 annually.

This amount is intended to cover various diagnostic tests and consultations.

Eligibility criteria for the Medical Check-Up facility are clearly defined.

Workers must be registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

To be eligible, workers must be actively engaged in the construction sector.

There is no specific age limit for eligibility under this scheme.

However, workers must provide proof of their employment in the construction industry.

The application process for availing the Medical Check-Up facility is straightforward.

Workers need to fill out an application form available at the local UKBOCWWB offices.

They must provide details such as their name, registration number, and contact information.

Additionally, applicants need to submit a copy of their registration certificate.

It is also necessary to provide identity proof such as an Aadhar card or voter ID.

Once the application is submitted, workers will receive a confirmation from the board.

The timeline for availing the medical check-up services is flexible.

Registered workers can apply for their check-ups at any time during the year.

The disbursement of health check-up services is carried out on a rolling basis.

Workers can access the services at designated health centers across Uttarakhand.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The board operates under the Department of Labour, Government of Uttarakhand.

Contact details for the UKBOCWWB can be found on their official website.

Workers can reach out to the board for any queries related to the scheme.

The UKBOCWWB also conducts awareness programs to educate workers about the benefits of the Medical Check-Up facility.

These programs aim to encourage more workers to utilize the health services available.

Statistics indicate that since the launch of the scheme, over 20,000 workers have benefitted from the medical check-ups.

The board has partnered with various hospitals and clinics to provide these services.

This partnership ensures that workers receive quality healthcare.

The scheme also emphasizes preventive healthcare measures.

Workers are educated about common health issues related to construction work.

The board provides information on safety measures and health practices.

Regular health check-ups can help in early detection of diseases.

This proactive approach is crucial for the long-term health of construction workers.

The Medical Check-Up facility is part of a broader initiative to enhance the welfare of workers in Uttarakhand.

The government recognizes the significant contributions of construction workers to the state's economy.

By providing health services, the government aims to improve productivity and reduce absenteeism.

The scheme is funded by the welfare cess collected from construction projects.

This cess is levied at a rate of 1% of the total cost of construction.

The funds collected are utilized for various welfare schemes for construction workers.

The UKBOCWWB also monitors the implementation of the Medical Check-Up facility.

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme.

Feedback from workers is collected to improve the services offered.

The board is committed to ensuring that all registered workers are aware of their rights and benefits.

The Medical Check-Up facility is a significant step towards ensuring the health and safety of construction workers.

It reflects the government's commitment to worker welfare and health.

The scheme is aligned with national health policies aimed at improving access to healthcare for all.

Overall, the Medical Check-Up facility under UKBOCWWB is a vital initiative.

It provides essential health services to a vulnerable segment of the workforce.

The scheme has the potential to significantly improve the quality of life for construction workers in Uttarakhand.

By ensuring regular health check-ups, the government is taking proactive steps towards worker welfare.

This initiative is a model for similar programs in other states across India.

The success of the Medical Check-Up facility can inspire further welfare measures for construction workers.

In conclusion, the Medical Check-Up facility under the UKBOCWWB is a comprehensive health initiative.

It aims to provide free and accessible healthcare to construction workers in Uttarakhand.

With specific eligibility criteria and a straightforward application process, the scheme is designed to be user-friendly.

The financial assistance provided ensures that workers can access necessary health services without financial burden.

The ongoing efforts to promote awareness and education among workers further enhance the scheme's impact.

The Medical Check-Up facility is a testament to the government's dedication to improving the health and welfare of construction workers.
